definitions.explanation: A condition of infrequent or difficult bowel movements.

examples.japanese: {便秘|べんぴ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{悩|なや}んでいる→悩む：02380_nayamu⟧。
{便秘|べんぴ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{解消|かいしょう}→解消：14143_kaishou⟧⟦するには→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{食物繊維|しょくもつせんい}→食物繊維：15118_shokumotsuseni⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{大切|たいせつ}→大切：01456_taisetsu⟧⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。
examples.english: Fiber is important for relieving constipation.

examples.japanese: ⟦{便秘薬|べんぴやく}→便秘薬：28831_benpiyaku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{飲|の}んだ→飲む：00322_nomu⟧。

notes:
{便秘|べんぴ} refers to constipation. It can function as a noun or as a する verb ({便秘|べんぴ}する, to be constipated). This is a useful word to know when visiting a doctor or pharmacy in Japan.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {便秘|べんぴ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧: to become constipated
- {便秘|べんぴ}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to be constipated
- {便秘|べんぴ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{悩|なや}む→悩む：02380_nayamu⟧: to suffer from constipation
- ⟦{便秘気味|べんぴぎみ}→便秘気味：noentry⟧: tending toward constipation
- {便秘|べんぴ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{解消|かいしょう}→解消：14143_kaishou⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to relieve constipation

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{便秘薬|べんぴやく}→便秘薬：28831_benpiyaku⟧ / ⟦{下剤|げざい}→下剤：28835_gezai⟧: laxative
- ⟦{下痢|げり}→下痢：05382_geri⟧: diarrhea (opposite condition)
- ⟦お{通|つう}じ→お通じ：28832_otsuuji⟧: bowel movement (euphemistic, polite)

AT THE DOCTOR:
{便秘|べんぴ}がちです (I tend to get constipated) is a common way to describe chronic symptoms to a doctor.
